name: MIKAN
source:
An AI (artificial human) that serves [url=/c124122]Futaba[/url].
It is linked to the main quantum computer of Futaba's spaceship "Starrim", this AI's intellectual ability far surpasses that of humans. Despite that she is quite clumsy indeed.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20050312000200/http://www.h7.dion.ne.jp/~nagikaze/enrai.html#no_2]official website[/url].]
